name: cockroach_clinical_memory_skill
description: Machine-executable Agent Skill for hierarchical agentic memory retrieval, transactional lock arbitration, and vector similarity search in CockroachDB.
author: AegisMed Core Team

capabilities.name: episodic_vector_search
capabilities.description: Executes cosine similarity vector search over longitudinal clinical encounters using CockroachDB pgvector extension.
capabilities.sql_template: SELECT episode_uid, chief_complaint, diagnosis, prescribed_medications, (1.0 - (embedding <=> :query_vector)) AS similarity FROM clinical_episodes WHERE patient_uid = :patient_uid ORDER BY embedding <=> :query_vector ASC LIMIT :top_k;

capabilities.name: acquire_session_lock
capabilities.description: Acquires a pessimistic SERIALIZABLE row lock on working memory state to synchronize concurrent multi-agent swarms in CockroachDB.
capabilities.sql_template: SELECT session_id, version, active_agent, lock_owner FROM working_memory_sessions WHERE session_id = :session_id FOR UPDATE;

capabilities.name: reconcile_delayed_telemetry
capabilities.description: Inserts out-of-order delayed telemetry observations and performs deterministic replay of subsequent episodes.
capabilities.sql_template: INSERT INTO clinical_episodes (episode_uid, patient_uid, timestamp, chief_complaint, diagnosis, lab_results, embedding) VALUES (:episode_uid, :patient_uid, :delayed_timestamp, :chief_complaint, :diagnosis, :lab_results, :embedding);
